claim_boundaries: Every metric is a label-free geometry, appearance, or provenance proxy; none measures accuracy.
Expected touched parts per substep are agent-authored assumptions layered on agent-authored substeps, not ground truth.
Skin and yellow color bands are derived from the retained artifacts themselves and are review proxies only.
Thresholds apply uniformly to the whole minute; no threshold was tuned to a specific reported frame range.
